# Ebook

> Ebook is a small online store selling four PDF guides on AI tools, money habits, gut health and sleep routines. Each ebook is $5.99; all four are $15.99.

## Ebooks
- [AI Money Machine](https://abubakarmubashir558-create.github.io/Ebook-/ai-money-machine.html): A practical guide to exploring AI-assisted services, digital tools and your first client-ready workflow.
- [Gut Reset](https://abubakarmubashir558-create.github.io/Ebook-/gut-reset.html): A 30-day educational guide to the gut microbiome, food choices and everyday wellbeing habits.
- [The Gen Z Wealth Code](https://abubakarmubashir558-create.github.io/Ebook-/gen-z-wealth-code.html): An introduction to money habits, digital skills and ways to think about building long-term financial capability.
- [Sleep Like a CEO](https://abubakarmubashir558-create.github.io/Ebook-/sleep-like-a-ceo.html): An educational guide to sleep routines, common disruptors and building a more consistent wind-down.
